Houston, remember "Martin Lawrence Live: Runteldat"? The energy of that special is coming to town! Martin Lawrence brings his high-energy and engaging storytelling to the stage. Known for animated, observational humor, he dives into themes of culture and self-deprecation. Imagine Eddie Murphy’s style with a bit more physical comedy. 

Smart Financial Centre at Sugar Land · Friday, June 5, 2026

Jeff Dunham's "Spark of Insanity" had us all in stitches. Houston, get ready for that same magic live. Jeff brings his unique ventriloquism to life with characters that are both hilarious and thought-provoking. His shows are known for selling out, blending sharp social commentary with unforgettable puppet routines. Don't miss your chance to see him in action.
